name: Sivaprakash J
description: AeroPulse is an Airfare Price Index system that tracks and analyzes flight fare trends across major Indian routes. It collects and cleans flight price data, calculates route-level and national airfare indices using weighted index methodology, and presents the results through an interactive dashboard. The system provides airfare trends, route comparisons, booking-horizon analysis, and route predictions to help users understand fare movements and make better travel decisions.
